replies.author: toketrain
replies.body:
this is great! glad it ended up good, although i would highly suggest adding more structure.

i would add some small buildings/towers surrounding each monument. if you're having trouble with detail, i'd refer to koodalord's post about detail building, and watch some youtube videos. it may seem like a waste of time, but in the long run, watching other people build on servers and practicing for a while gave me lots more skill in doing buildings.
